Privacy policy

Version 1.0 · Effective September 21, 2026

This policy covers the VolaVPN app ("Vola") for iPhone. Vola is published by Bluebird Connect LLC ("we", "us"). If you have a question about it, write to bluebirdconnect2026@gmail.com.

In short

  • No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking.
  • Your line details and the logbook stay on this iPhone. Passwords are kept in the iOS Keychain.
  • While you use the starter line, your internet traffic passes through a server we operate.
  • Traffic on your own line goes to your server. We can't see it.
  • The exit check and Pulse contact third-party services, which see your public IP address.
  • We don't sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising or any other purpose.

What Vola keeps on this iPhone

  • Your lines: name, server address, Remote ID and username, in the app's settings on this iPhone.
  • Passwords: in the iOS Keychain, one item per line, available only on this iPhone after it has been unlocked once since it started.
  • Rules and your agreement to this policy: in the app's settings on this iPhone.
  • Staying safe progress: which tips you have marked as read, in the app's settings on this iPhone. Vola doesn't record what you open or how long you read.
  • Logbook: a file in the app's storage. It lists connections, proof runs, starter-line events, renamed lines and lines shared with their password. It never contains a password, and starter-line entries never contain the starter server's address.
  • Starter window: the time you first opened Vola, in the iOS Keychain with a copy in the app's settings. iOS usually keeps Keychain items when an app is deleted, so reinstalling Vola usually doesn't restart the two hours.

None of this is sent to us. Vola has no account and no server that receives your lines, passwords or logbook.

The starter line

The starter line is open for 2 hours from the first time you open Vola. It is operated by Bluebird Connect LLC.

While you use the starter line, your internet traffic passes through that server. We keep no record of the sites you visit or the contents of your traffic. We don't use this data for anything other than running the starter line and the purposes described above. We don't sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising or any other purpose. The only third-party contacts are the exit check and Pulse described below, which see your public IP address.

Vola shows you who runs the starter line and what passes through it before you can connect to it.

Your own lines

Traffic on your own line goes to your server. We can't see it. The server, its provider and what passes through it are yours to choose and manage.

When you run a proof, Vola looks up your server's address using this iPhone's usual DNS settings, connects to your server and holds the connection for 10 seconds.

When Vola contacts others

  • Exit check: only when you tap it, and during a proof run, Vola asks ipinfo.io for your public address. That service sees your public IP address.
  • Pulse: while a line is on and Vola is open, Vola times opening a connection to Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 (port 443) through the active line, every 10 seconds. That service sees your public IP address.
  • Links you tap, such as the setup script or the support page, open in Safari.

Vola doesn't contact any other service.

Camera, photos, Face ID and notifications

  • Camera: used only to scan a line's QR code, and only after you tap Start scanning. Images aren't saved or uploaded.
  • Photos: when you choose a QR image, Vola reads only the picture you pick. It doesn't need access to your photo library.
  • Face ID or passcode: used only to confirm that you want to share a line with its password. iOS does the check and tells Vola only whether it passed. Vola never receives biometric data.
  • Notifications: only if you turn on the reminder. They are scheduled on this iPhone. Vola doesn't use remote push notifications.

Sharing and importing lines

When you share a line, Vola shows its QR code on screen or passes the line to the place you pick in the share sheet. It doesn't go through us, and Vola never sends a shared line over the network by itself.

A line shared with its password lets anyone who has it use your server, and their traffic goes out through your server. You decide who gets it, and you're responsible for that. Vola can't take back a line you've shared; to stop someone using your server, delete or reset their user on the server.

A line you scan, paste or open from a link stays in memory until you save it. Nothing is saved or connected until you tap Save.

Deleting your data

  • Delete a line in Lines. Its saved password is removed too.
  • Clear the logbook in Logbook.
  • Erase Vola data in Paperwork removes your lines and their passwords, the logbook, your rules, your agreement to this policy, your Staying safe progress, and Vola's VPN configuration. It doesn't reset the starter window.
  • Delete the app. iOS may keep the starter window's Keychain item.

Data on the starter line's server is handled as described in "The starter line" above.

Children

Vola is not directed to children. It has no accounts, and we don't knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to this policy

When this policy changes, we update the version and effective date here and in the app. If a change affects what passes through the starter line, Vola asks for your agreement again before you connect.
